abilities.name: Bile and breath
abilities.summary: Three recurring casts pressure the group.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Keep healing available for both Rain of Bile and Fetid Breath, each recurring once a minute after its initial cast.
Disconcerting Presence recurs every two minutes.
The combat timers stop on disengagement.
